title: 중소기업은행법제54조제6항시행에관한규정 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Performance of Affairs on Behalf of Commission)
The Financial Services Commission may have the President of the Industrial Bank of Korea perform on its behalf affairs concerning the receipt of applications for acquisition of private investments or the payment of acquisition proceeds. [Amended on February 29, 2008.]
